description: This file defines various template metaprogramming utilities and type traits within the WPEFramework namespace, including pick, func_traits, enable_if, is_same, inherits, and macros for checking member and static member availability.

classes.name: pick
classes.description: Template struct to select a type from a parameter pack based on an index.

classes.name: func_traits
classes.description: Template struct to extract traits from various function types, including member functions, function pointers, and std::function.

classes.name: same_or_inherits
classes.description: Template struct to check if two types are the same or if one inherits from the other.

classes.name: sign
classes.description: Template struct to determine if a type is signed.
